title: County funding for Lahaina Community Land Trust
summary: On April 21, a council member proposed a new $6 million grant to the Lahaina Community Land Trust to help wildfire survivors with gaps in rebuilding money. She said the trust raised over $9.5 million using the County's first $6 million. Earlier, the council gave the trust $5 million in managed retreat funds, and testifiers asked that $6 million in unrestricted funding be restored.
